ui.title: Interface

stt.title: Transcription

local.name: Local · Parakeet
local.hint: On your Mac: audio never leaves the machine and it works offline. Needs the models below.

deepgram.name: Cloud · Deepgram
deepgram.hint: Low latency and strong on difficult audio; audio is sent to Deepgram's servers. The API key stays in the macOS Keychain: create one at console.deepgram.com.

stt.lockedByLocalOnly: With "Local only" on, the local engine is always used.
stt.needKey: A Deepgram API key is required to transcribe with Deepgram.
stt.needModels: To transcribe locally, download the models in Settings.

language.mineHint: A fixed language is more accurate than automatic.
language.theirsHint: Automatic: favours Italian and English, also handles language switching.

key.replacePlaceholder: Paste a new key to replace it

llm.title: Language model

ollama.name: Ollama (local)
ollama.hint: Runs on your Mac: nothing leaves the machine and no key is needed. Start Ollama and pull a model (e.g. ollama pull qwen3:8b).

opencode.name: OpenCode Zen
opencode.hint: Pay-per-use cloud (Zen credits). The API key stays in the macOS Keychain: create it in the opencode.ai console under Account → Personal API keys. Only compatible models (chat completions) are listed.

opencode-go.name: OpenCode Go
opencode-go.hint: OpenCode Go subscription, same console API key (Account → Personal API keys). Go is meant for coding agents and traffic is monitored: meeting use may get the account limited. Only compatible models are listed.

openai.name: OpenAI
openai.hint: Pay-per-use cloud. The API key stays in the macOS Keychain: create it on platform.openai.com → API keys. Only chat models are listed (e.g. gpt-5.4-mini for translation).

anthropic.name: Anthropic (Claude)
anthropic.hint: Pay-per-use cloud, Claude's native API. The API key stays in the macOS Keychain: create it on platform.claude.com → API keys. claude-haiku-5-5 is enough for translation.

custom.name: Custom
custom.hint: Any OpenAI-compatible endpoint (Groq, OpenRouter, LM Studio…). The key is optional and stays in the Keychain.

llm.translationHint: Small and fast: translates the others' sentences.
llm.autoTranslateHint: Translates every sentence from the others. Off: use the “Translate” button next to the sentence.
llm.targetHint: Language you read the others' sentences in.
llm.autoSummaryHint: On stop, generate overview, key points and action items.

localOnly.title: Local only
localOnly.hint: For confidential meetings: transcription on your Mac and a language model only on Ollama or a localhost endpoint. No data leaves the machine during the session.
localOnly.violation: The selected language model runs in the cloud: with "Local only" the session won't start. Switch to Ollama or a localhost endpoint, or clear the translation and suggestion models.

speakers.title: Recognize speakers
speakers.hint: Tells apart who is speaking among the other participants (Speaker 1, 2…). Runs locally and needs the CAM++ model.
speakers.countHint: If you know how many there are, recognition is steadier and fixes sentences already shown.

permissions.hint: On first launch macOS asks for microphone and system audio recording permission.

header.ready: Ready: start when the call begins

mode.localHint: No data leaves this computer during the session
mode.cloudHint: Audio or text is sent to external services

talk.title: Talk time
talk.label: Me {{me}}% · Them {{them}}%
talk.empty: Talk time appears with the transcript

models.title: Local models
models.hint: Transcribe and recognize speakers without sending audio to third parties. Models stay on your Mac and work offline once downloaded.

history.title: History
history.select: Pick a meeting from the list.
history.deleteConfirm: Delete this meeting? Sentences and translations will be lost.
